related.title: Google SRE：以請求計算SLO與錯誤預算
related.titleEn: Google SRE: request-based SLOs and error budgets
related.why:
用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付 spans.csv、union-intervals.csv與串/並行情境比較。
另一位學徒應能從原始輸入重算結果並重現至少一個反例。
related.whyEn:
Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver spans.csv,union-intervals.csv and serial/parallel comparisons.
A second learner must reproduce results and at least one counterexample from the original inputs.
related.difference: 使用整數分數1/1000交叉核對預算100；本窗超支20，短窗burn rate2。不得將重試次數混入使用者請求分母。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Cross-check budget100 using exact fraction1/1000;the main window overspends by20 and short-window burn rate is2. Do not mix retries into the user-request denominator. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
基準 (110-10)+(140-60) = 180 ms；對照 100+80-50 = 130 ms。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
排序區間端點求聯集[10,140]，子活動聯集130 ms；父區間剩20 ms。這不直接等於CPU時間或全分散式關鍵路徑。

基準 100000*(1-0.999) = 100.00000000000009 events；對照 (40/20000)/(1-0.999) = 1.9999999999999982 burn-rate。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
使用整數分數1/1000交叉核對預算100；本窗超支20，短窗burn rate2。不得將重試次數混入使用者請求分母。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Baseline (110-10)+(140-60) = 180 ms; comparison 100+80-50 = 130 ms. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Sweep interval endpoints to obtain union[10,140],130 ms,leaving20 ms of the parent outside children; neither quantity directly measures CPU time or an entire distributed critical path.

Baseline 100000*(1-0.999) = 100.00000000000009 events; comparison (40/20000)/(1-0.999) = 1.9999999999999982 burn-rate. Annotate units,denominators,rounding and applicability separately.
Cross-check budget100 using exact fraction1/1000;the main window overspends by20 and short-window burn rate is2. Do not mix retries into the user-request denominator.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 先按transaction_id與currency分組核對零差額；再核對收入/稅科目分類，證明兩組皆平衡但業務含義不同。 完成預測、觀察與反例的對照。
related.differenceEn: Group by transaction_id and currency to verify zero difference,then inspect account classification to show both balanced entries mean different things. Compare prediction,observation and counterexamples.

基準 1000-900-100 = 0 currency-units；對照 1000-800-200 = 0 currency-units。逐項註記單位、分母、取整與適用域。
